item.title: Commitment to Sustainable Fiber Innovation
item.description:
Commitment to Sustainable Fiber Innovation
#

Acelon Chemicals & Fiber Corporation was established in 1988 by a group of partners united by their passion and vision for the textile industry. Over the years, the company has experienced steady growth, expanding its operations from 1988 to 2009. Today, Acelon operates three manufacturing facilities located in Puyan, Fangyuan, and Douliu, specializing in the production of nylon and polyester yarns.
